architecture: architecture-independent abstract Decoder input; locked uintb/u64 host ABI is x86_64-linux-gnu
compiler_spec: none; no compiler-spec model or AddrSpaceManager participates in RangeProperties::decode

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of locked RangeProperties::decode against a deterministic Decoder virtual object; no Architecture, Actions, SSA, or C emission
analysis_options.decoder: Ordered attributes are supplied directly by an abstract Decoder with locked global ids range=12, register=14, name=14, space=20, first=27, last=28, and raw unknown=159; the tree_decoder_unregistered case additionally drives the real XmlDecode/TreeDecoder over an in-memory Element whose unregistered attribute name xmlunknown-attr is resolved through the production name-to-id lookup. Ordinary close records but does not traverse two synthetic children
analysis_options.prestate: Fresh constructor state plus one persistent object decoded three times to expose non-reset and exception residue
analysis_options.observation: Return/error domain, exact error text, all five fields, complete virtual-call order, decoder-open state, children present at close, child-open count, and peek count
analysis_options.normalization: No field, integer, ordering, trace event, child count, or error text normalization. The Rust anyhow carrier is serialized under the corresponding DecoderError semantic label; carrier-type equivalence is explicitly not claimed.

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: defaults: empty <range> preserves constructor state and performs open,next-0,close
ordered_unknown: an abstract Decoder directly supplies raw id 159 between space and first; source order is retained and this supplied nonzero unknown id does not terminate traversal
name_then_space: <register> name sets isRegister, later space overwrites spaceName without clearing the flag
range_name: <range> name still sets register state and last accepts uintb maximum
duplicates: repeated last/name plus intervening space use last-write-wins while flags remain sticky
persistent_first: register name and last establish persistent state
persistent_second: a later range containing only first does not reset any other field
invalid_after_success: unexpected element throws before attribute traversal/close and preserves prior object state while decoder stays open
child_unvisited: two children are present at ordinary close, with zero peek and zero child-open calls
u64_boundary: explicit first zero and last 18446744073709551615

tree_decoder_unregistered: the real XmlDecode/TreeDecoder over an in-memory <range> element resolves the unregistered attribute name xmlunknown-attr to id 159 and traversal continues through first and last

observation_schema.format: Twelve fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus eleven case records
observation_schema.state: spaceName, first, last, isRegister, seenLast after each return or exception
observation_schema.decoder: Exact open/next/read/close trace plus open residue, children-at-close, child opens, and peeks
observation_schema.error: Ghidra DecoderError/Rust result adapter category and exact message

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-range-properties-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI view with sizeof static assertion and -fno-strict-aliasing; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/address.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs Cargo locked+offline against only the checksum-verified vendor tree, compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again
